svg.text: A fall, a rebound, and a notch turned over.
Brand guide · Vasco Kaufmann Figueiredo, full-stack web developer, Lisbon
The V is the fall and the rebound.
The triangle is the V's own notch,
Grid and unit: 1u is the arm, 0.226 of the
height. Arms run 21.5° off plumb, the foot is
The triangle appears once: in the mark, and
as the full stop of the name. Never a row of them.
The mark never replaces a letter of the name.
Nor stands beside or above it: “V Vasco” stutters, and “VAsco” reads as VSCO. Ranked by first choice:
COLOUR · 60 GROUND / 30 INK / 10 BLUE AND ORANGE
